comment: The parameter indices do not follow the panel: the enum interleaves the five voices (PUSH_KK is 0, LINK_KK 1, LINK_OH 2, PUSH_CH 3 and so on), so tagging from index order would attach every line to the wrong voice. The panel order left to right is snare, open hat, kick, closed hat, clap, and the tags here follow the census x positions. The manual says Push "boosts the signal level 50%"; applyBoost in helpers/dsp_utils.hpp:198 multiplies by 1.5 and then clamps to ±1 before the volume stage, so a loud sample is clipped rather than made louder. Decay times of 80ms to 800ms come from DecayEnvelope in helpers/dsp_utils.hpp:113-122; the manual gives no figures. Panning is applied only to the stereo mix, never to the individual outputs. Every jack is read with getVoltage(), so nothing is polyphonic.
